title: Nihongo AutoDrop
description: A client-side Fabric mod that automatically drops unwanted items with an easy in-game filter menu.
body:
## Nihongo AutoDrop

Keep your inventory clean and organized with **Nihongo AutoDrop** — a lightweight, client-side Fabric mod for Minecraft 1.20.1 and older versions.  

### ✨ Features
- **Smart item search**: Quickly find any item in your inventory.  
- **Simple filter control**: Double-click to add or remove items from the auto-drop list.  
- **Automatic cleanup**: Selected items are instantly discarded when they appear in your inventory.  
- **Toggle on/off**: Enable or disable auto-drop with a single button for full control.  

### 🎮 Why use Nihongo AutoDrop?
No more cluttered inventories or endless manual dropping. This mod gives you a clear, customizable way to manage unwanted items, making gameplay smoother and more enjoyable.  

### ⚙️ Compatibility
- Works only on the **client side** — it does not alter server logic.  
- Designed for **Fabric 1.20.1** with planned support for older versions.  
- Server usage depends on individual server rules.
